page.layout: One printed page: main text in one column on the left; a narrow strip of cropped marginal text along the right edge (fragmentary, mostly illegible from the scan). Running head at top centre.

main_text.p: igitur hisce opinionibus contra-dixerit jure, tantum abest ut in jus hunc, vel ego, vel patruelis meus autor vocare, eique litem move-re velimus, ut potius gratias illi simus acturi. Quare enim non agnosceremus beneficium ejus, qui nos errore liberaret? Quare non agnosceremus veritatem o-stensam, eiq; gratularemur? cui frustra & non sine peccato bono-rumque offensione essemus contradicturi? Hæc enim tandem, omnibus etiam reclamantibus, vincet & hostes suos sub jugum mittet. Scribat igitur alius contra hæsce meditationes; sentiat judicet, quidquid velit, modo eo animo scribat, ut id quod dixi, beneficium in nos collatum & veritatem agnoscere & exosculari possi-

page.notes: Right edge strip contains cropped fragments of marginal notes, not legible enough to transcribe. Catchword "possi-" is a line-end word fragment at the foot; kept only in bottom_margin as it appears printed beneath the last line. Long s rendered as plain s; i/j and u/v normalised.
